mapper.select: INSERT INTO rsku_code_counter (rspu_code, factory_code, material_code, sequence_value, updated_at) VALUES (#{rspuCode}, #{factoryCode}, #{materialCode}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (rspu_code, factory_code, material_code) DO UPDATE SET sequence_value = rsku_code_counter.sequence_value + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING sequence_value
